limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, practitioner, compiler, runtime, storage, networking, railway, medical, clinical, device, driver, hardware, real-time, functional-safety, cybersecurity, certification, regulatory, quality, or human-factors review is claimed. Source checking, abstract classification, and manual reasoning do not prove a constructor cannot escape, every reachable node immutable, a real carrier matched, reclamation safe, a file durable, a message delivered, a device ordered, a deadline met, or deployment safe.
